title: Red-team break-in at a consolidated allied intelligence facility

tellings.quote: he and I broke in to this 30,000 C facility

plain: A remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle says that in the 1970s in Germany, he and a colleague broke into a large consolidated allied intelligence facility as a red team, people who play attackers to test security. McMoneagle tells it as something he did himself, and it suggests how weak the protection of sensitive sites could be.
